## Checklist (Tier 0 — solo / self-host / no-PII)

- [ ] Strongly typed; no `any` introduced
- [ ] Inputs validated where applicable
- [ ] No secrets committed; `.env` untouched
- [ ] Conventional Commit messages
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated if a significant decision was made
- [ ] Change is reversible (safe migration / rollback noted)

- [ ] Security headers / rate limiting considered
- [ ] Privacy / erasure / AI-egress impact reviewed
